record.field: What do I do next on this screen?
Reads the shared screen and points at the next field or button.

Explain the sales flow for my products
Quotation to invoice, as this database is set up (not generic Odoo).

Pointer tour of the reconciliation screen with the person's own journal.
Show me on screen how to reconcile the bank statement lines of the journal {{journal}}: where to match an invoice, how to write off a small difference, and how to leave a line for later.
Why is this product's stock negative?
Traces the moves that pushed the on-hand quantity below zero.
